subject: chemistry
text: The number of electrons in sulphur atom having \(n + l = 3\)?

solution.text:
(d)
The electronic configuration of sulphur atom is \(1s^2 2s^2 2p^6 3s^2 3p^4\). The orbitals with \((n + l) = 3\) are 2p (2+1=3) and 3s (3+0=3), therefore 8 electrons (6 in 2p + 2 in 3s) in sulphur atom have \((n + l) = 3\).

text: For an electron, with n = 3 has only one radial node. The orbital angular momentum of the electron will be

solution.text:
(c)

text: An organic compound has an empirical formula of \(\text{CH}_2\text{O}\). If its vapour density is 30, what is its molecular formula?

solution.text:
(B) 1. Molar Mass = \(2 \times \text{Vapour Density} = 2 \times 30 = 60\text{ g/mol}\)
2. Empirical Formula Mass (\(\text{CH}_2\text{O}\)) = \(12 + 2(1) + 16 = 30\text{ g/mol}\)
3. Ratio n = \(\frac{\text{Molar Mass}}{\text{Empirical Mass}} = \frac{60}{30} = 2\)
4. Molecular Formula = \((\text{CH}_2\text{O})_2 = \text{C}_2\text{H}_4\text{O}_2\)
